$comment: CI run of eval/cases/build-test.json against forge-test-mcp 0.1.0 from npm, in the pinned no-network container (EVAL.yml probe job), one job per forge version. Each run object is that job's cases.json artifact, unchanged. An earlier run on this branch (40359297437, commit aab64dc) reported 4/22 because forge was not reachable inside the container (a dangling symlink in the harness setup); that run is not evidence about the candidate, and the harness now exits 2 instead of reporting cases when a required binary does not run.

solc.via: FOUNDRY_SOLC (Linux binary pinned by sha256 in eval/deps.json)
